title: One Piece’s English Dub Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date for Elbaph Arc & More
content: One Piece: Elbaph Arc is nearing the end of its run this Summer, and thankfully Crunchyroll has finally set a release date for its English dub return with a newly confirmed release schedule.

title: Rock Band SCANDAL Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content: The official website of SCANDAL announced on Monday that the four-member all-female rock band will disband on August 21, 2027, following their final concert at the Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa Prefecture. The disbandment date will coincide with the band's 21st anniversary.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nekopara Sekai Connect Game Launches for PC on September 28
content: The game debuted on iOS and Android devices on April 14 in English and Japanese. The game commemorates the 10th anniversary of the franchise . Neko Works is credited for the production and editorial supervision, and Good Smile Company is credited for production and distribution.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major 2026 Anime Movie With New Look
content: A major movie released in Japan earlier this year, and now Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have confirmed that they will soon be bringing it to the United States with an official theatrical release.

title: The Summer Hikaru Died Gets New Summer Seasonal Illustration by Cypic
content: The Summer Hikaru Died anime received a new seasonal summer illustration by studio Cypic, featuring Hikaru and Yoshiki fishing together. The two main characters previously won the 2025 Best Ship or Couple award in our yearly ranking.
